QuestInfo.name: Batch Accept Grandis Daily Quests
QuestInfo.0:
#e[Batch Accept Grandis Daily Quests]#n

If you accept, you can accept all available Grandis Daily Quests at once.
However, quests where you haven't done the #rfirst guide quest#k, or where you've been #rremoved from the notifier#k, won't be included in this list.
